name: Canopy light interception
description: Canopy light interception was measured at 35, 69, and 95 DAP using a portable‑tube solarimeter with sensors for photosynthetically active radiation (PAR; AccuPAR-80, v. 4.5, Decagon Devices, Inc. Pullman, Washington).

name: Cover crop aboveground biomass was sampled
description: Cover crop aboveground biomass was sampled in both MCC and fallow treatments at -32 DAP. Three subplots of 60 by 50 cm were sampled in each main plot (MCC or fallow).

Disease evaluation for Sclerotium rolfsii Sacc. (Southern blight), a major problem in the entire field, consisted of individual assessment of plants in relation to disease symptoms at 74 DAP and harvest (111 DAP). Plants were scored on a scale from 1 to 5, where 1 was 0% of the individual plant affected, 2 (25%), 3 (50%), 4 (75%), and 5 (100% or dead).

name: Fruit color
description: Fruit color was determined as $L^*a^*b^*$ color values with a reflectance colorimeter (Minolta CR300 color meter) and expressed as hue angle (hue decreases as fruit develops red color).

name: Firmness was tested with a nondestructive tomato firmness device (Qualitest durometer)
description: Firmness was tested with a nondestructive tomato firmness device (Qualitest durometer) with values expressed as percent of maximum force (13 Newtons).

name: pH meter
description: pH was read directly on a pH meter.

name: soluble solids (SS)
description: SS were determined from samples frozen at -20°C, which were partially thawed, blended, filtered and measured on a digital refractometer

name: Titratable acidity (TA)
description: Titratable acidity (TA) was determined from 10‑mL juice, titrated with 0.1 N NaOH, and pH was read directly on a pH meter.

name: fumigation extraction
description: Microbial biomass carbon (MBC) was analyzed for the 0-15- and 15-30-cm depths using the fumigation extraction method, and total MBC was calculated by multiplying the flush of C by 2.64 (Vance et al. 1987).

name: gas emissions were sampled
description: using closed, capped chambers for 30 min (Rolston 1986)

name: Gravimetric soil moisture
description: Gravimetric soil moisture was determined at every sampling event.

name: colorimetric determination
description: Wellmixed soil subsamples were measured for KClextractable nitrate (NO 3 - ) and ammonium (NH 4 + ) with colorimetric determination using modifications of Miranda et al. (2001) and Foster (1995).

name: 2% acetic acid extraction
description: atomic absorption spectrometry or inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectrometry

name: total N
description: All plant samples were processed at the DANR Analytical Laboratory, UC Davis, for total N using a Nitrogen Gas Analyzer (LECO FP-528, St. Joseph, MI)
